content.body:
The Energy bar shows your ability to spend energy by sprinting, crouching, crawling and swimming. For instance, when the energy bar is at half or less, you cannot sprint. The bar will refill at different rates depending on your activity.
You regain energy by resting, especially when laying prone.
Your accuracy with infantry weapons decreases with your energy level, so be careful about using all of your energy before the fight.
content.title: The Energy Bar
